'''Nandan Roty''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] officer of the [[Canto Bight Police Department]]. In around [[34 ABY]], he was playing a game of cards in the jail of the [[Canto Bight police headquarters]] when he and two of his colleagues were attacked by the [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]]. The [[droid]] managed to subdue the guards, and after defeating another officer, escaped with the criminal [[DJ]].

==Biography==
[[File:Nandan_Roty.png|thumb|left|250px|Nandan Roty was tied up by BB-8.]]
Nandan Roty<ref name="Card">{{Topps|set=2017 Topps Star Wars: The Last Jedi|cardname=Nandan Roty}}</ref> was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as an officer in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]]'s [[Canto Bight Police Department|police department]].<ref name="TLJ" /> In around [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] to [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] takes place immediately after the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it must also take place in approximately 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]].</ref> Roty joined a [[Gambling|game of cards]] being played by officer [[Stepheden Thaldree]] and another member of the department in the jail of the [[Canto Bight police headquarters]]. The trio was then attacked by the [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]], who was [[Mission to Canto Bight|seeking to free]] his comrades [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] from the jail.<ref name="TLJ" />

The [[droid]] managed to subdue all three officers and tie their hands and feet, also gagging Roty with his [[glove]]s. The criminal [[DJ]], who had just released himself from his cell, then discovered BB-8 and his three captives, each of whom gave muffled cries for the criminal to help them. Another officer then discovered the scene, and demanded BB-8 and DJ surrender; however, as Roty watched, BB-8 began launching [[coin]]s at the officer, who DJ then knocked out with his [[boot]]s. BB-8 and DJ then successfully escaped from the prison.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:NandanRoty-SWBC63.png|thumb|right|200px|Roty in his full armored uniform]]
Roty had fair skin, [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s and brown [[hair]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Equipment==
Roty wore the white, blue and black [[Clothing|uniform]] of the Canto Bight police department, including a [[betaplast]] [[armor]]ed collar and neck guard and a black [[Hat|helmet]]. He was equipped with an [[Electro-shock prod|electro-shock stun prod]], a [[Relby K-25 blaster]], a scrambled long-range [[comlink]] and a [[police glowrod]].<ref name="TLJ" /><ref name="TLJVD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Nandan Roty was portrayed by [[Andy Nyman]] in the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] and credited as "Jail Guard".<ref name="TLJ" /> The character was then named by a card released in the ''[[2017 Topps Star Wars: The Last Jedi|2017 Topps Star Wars The Last Jedi]]'' series of cards.<ref name="Card" />
